data.title: General Secretariat of Arab Interior Ministers Council Condemns Continued Hostile Acts by Terrorist Houthi Militia against Saudi Arabia
data.content:
Tunis, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The General Secretariat of the Arab Interior Ministers Council expressed its absolute condemnation and strong denunciation of the terrorist Houthi militia's continued hostile acts against Saudi Arabia and its recent deliberate attempts to target civilian and economic facilities in Riyadh, which resulted in material damage to a civilian tower.
    In a statement issued today from its headquarters in the Tunisian capital, the general secretariat condemned the repeated attacks and hostile approach adopted by the terrorist militia in targeting civilian facilities and endangering civilian lives and property, describing these acts as a flagrant violation of international law and international humanitarian law.
    The general secretariat stressed the need to hold those responsible for these acts accountable and ensure they do not go unpunished. It reiterated its full solidarity with Saudi Arabia, its support for the Kingdom, and its unwavering backing for all measures taken to confront these threats, protect its security, and safeguard its sovereignty, stability, territorial integrity, and the safety of its citizens and residents.
    -- SPA
